workflow.name: Discover
workflow.what: Find out who reads it, what they're trying to do and what's true now. I read the source, run the product and ask the engineers.
workflow.artifact: The audit of the help-center article: 14 findings, two critical, one checked on the server.

workflow.name: Structure
workflow.what: Split content by what the reader needs: a concept, a task, a reference, a fix. One purpose per page.
workflow.artifact: One article became a concept, a how-to, a reference and a troubleshooting page.

workflow.name: Write
workflow.what: Short sentences, one action per step, the result the reader should see, labels exactly as on screen.
workflow.artifact: The MDX source of the how-to, with front matter, a shared partial and captioned screenshots.

workflow.name: Review
workflow.what: Check every claim against the product, then the page against a checklist. AI drafts get the same review.
workflow.artifact: The review checklist, and an AI draft whose false step the review caught.

workflow.name: Validate
workflow.what: Lint with Vale, build with broken-link checks, test translation readiness with a pseudo-locale.
workflow.artifact: Four Vale runs, from 7 errors in the original to 0, and every decision recorded.

workflow.name: Publish
workflow.what: Merge, build, publish. The source stays one click away from the page.
workflow.artifact: The published Docusaurus site, with an edit link on every page.

workflow.name: Maintain
workflow.what: Revise when the product or the need changes, test the change, and say what changed.
workflow.artifact: Versions 1.1 and 1.2: a REST API method and a safer order of the steps, each tested on the server.

Self-editing and SME review at MongoDB; review checklists at Magna. The case study records every editorial decision on Vale's findings.
